cond_0001.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. The position involves routine laboratory tasks to assist team members with lab maintenance, cleanliness, and preparations.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Schedule preparation of routine laboratory buffers and solutions; maintain and reorder materials for buffers.
Complete daily laboratory walk-throughs and safety checks.
Store and dispose of hazardous wastes using safety procedures; assist in informing supervisor and staff of proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
Enforce lab safety codes in all lab areas to ensure employee safety.
Communicate with laboratory supervisor regarding special needs and maintenance of laboratory facilities as needed.
Support inventory tracking system in place for all science supplies and special equipment.
Coordinate purchasing of supplies and special equipment with laboratory supervisor.
Assist with maintenance of laboratory equipment (service or replace).
Maintain cleanliness and organization within lab spaces, entrance areas, gowning rooms, lab hallways, and lab management storage areas.
Maintain a reference library of scientific catalogs, instruction manuals, keys, troubleshooting guides, and operation and parts manuals for laboratory equipment and models as requested.
Perform assigned responsibilities, duties, and tasks according to established practices, procedures, techniques, and standards in a safe manner and with minimal supervision.
Interact with equipment vendors on service calls.
Manage reagent / common consumables store / liaison with VWR.
Liaison with EH&S and lab waste disposal services.
Co-ordinate access requests and lab safety training.
Communicate and co-ordinate lab usage requests / requirements.
Daily lab maintenance / common area cleanup / lab space storage.
Familiarity with safety data sheets and chemical hygiene practices.
Complete simple ad-hoc requests from supervisors/managers and/or lab users.
Ability to read, understand, and comply with detailed procedures that ensure the safety of all.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize duties to meet timelines.
Strong communication, organizational and time management skills are essential.
Detail-oriented and conscientious.
Perform clerical tasks as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
Knowledge of basic laboratory and clerical procedures
Knowledge of laboratory safety rules, policies and procedures
Knowledge of Material Safety Data Sheets
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions in written, oral, and diagram form
Ability to perform all essential functions using safe work methods and following safety regulations
Ability to operate laboratory and office equipment
Ability to accurately perform math calculations, solution preparations and troubleshoot when needed
Ability to write routine reports and correspondence
Sufficient physical ability to work in a lab setting: stand or sit for prolonged periods; occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; lift, carry, push, and/or pull up to 25 pounds
Vision in the normal visual range with or without correction
Familiarity with current information technology including Microsoft Office, Outlook, and standard office machines
Preferred Requirements
Related work or school experience
Knowledge of ordering supplies and maintaining inventories of laboratory supplies/equipment
Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully with a variety of people including laboratory employees, staff, outside suppliers, and the general public
Ability to manage interpersonal conflict situations requiring tact, diplomacy, and discretion
Ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and a wide variety of co-workers
Ability to follow technical instructions, procedure manuals, and charts to solve practical problems and/or ensure compliance with clear guidelines and standards
Ability to interpret policy and establish methods and procedures

cond_0008.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team to provide routine laboratory tasks, assisting with lab maintenance, cleanliness, and preparations.
cond_0008.responsibilities:
Employee must be able to perform the following functions to the satisfaction of the employee's supervisor.
Schedule and execute preparation of routine laboratory buffers and solutions; maintain and reorder materials for buffers.
Lead daily laboratory walk-throughs and safety checks.
Store and dispose of hazardous wastes using safety procedures; take ownership of informing supervisor and staff of proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
Enforce lab safety codes in all lab areas to ensure employee safety.
Communicate with laboratory supervisor regarding special needs and maintenance of laboratory facilities as needed.
Drive inventory tracking for all science supplies and special equipment.
Direct purchasing of supplies and special equipment in coordination with the laboratory supervisor.
Manage maintenance of laboratory equipment (service or replace).
Maintain cleanliness and organization within lab spaces, entrance areas, gowning rooms, lab hallways, and lab management storage areas.
Maintain a reference library of scientific catalogs, instruction manuals, keys, troubleshooting guides, and operation and parts manuals for laboratory equipment and models as requested.
Execute assigned responsibilities, duties, and tasks according to established practices, procedures, techniques, and standards in a safe manner and with minimal supervision.
Lead coordination with equipment vendors on service calls.
Manage reagent / common consumables store; liaise with VWR.
Liaise with EH&S and lab waste disposal services.
Own access requests and lab safety training coordination.
Manage lab usage requests and requirements.
Direct daily lab maintenance, common area cleanup, and lab space storage.
Apply familiarity with safety data sheets and chemical hygiene practices.
Complete ad-hoc requests from supervisors/managers and/or lab users.
Additional Duties:
Perform clerical tasks as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned.
cond_0008.requirements:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, in a tactful and courteous manner with a variety of people, including laboratory employees, staff, outside suppliers, and the general public
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules; ability to write routine reports and correspondence
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions in written, oral, and diagram form
Knowledge of basic laboratory and clerical procedures; ability to operate laboratory and office equipment
Knowledge of Material Safety Data Sheets and laboratory safety rules, policies, and procedures
Ability to perform all essential functions using safe work methods and following safety regulations
Ability to accurately perform math calculations, solution preparations, and troubleshoot when needed
Ability to multi-task and prioritize duties to meet timelines
Strong communication, organizational, and time management skills
Detail-oriented and conscientious
Physical ability to work in a lab setting: stand or sit for prolonged periods; occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; lift, carry, push, and/or pull up to 25 pounds; operate equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard
Vision in the normal visual range with or without correction
Preferred Requirements
Related work or school experience
Ability to manage interpersonal conflict situations requiring tact, diplomacy, and discretion
Ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and a wide variety of co-workers
Ability to interpret policy and establish methods and procedures
Knowledge of ordering supplies and maintaining inventories of laboratory supplies/equipment
Familiarity with current lab equipment and information technology used by the department, including Microsoft Office, Outlook, and standard office machines

People usually grow into this kind of lab work over time as they build experience and learn from day-to-day tasks.
cond_0095.responsibilities:
Schedule preparation of routine laboratory buffers and solutions; maintain and reorder materials for buffers
Complete daily laboratory walk-throughs and safety checks.
Store and dispose of hazardous wastes using safety procedures; assist in informing supervisor and staff of proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
Enforce lab safety codes in all lab areas to ensure employee safety.
Communicate with laboratory supervisor regarding special needs and maintenance of laboratory facilities as needed.
Support inventory tracking system in place for all science supplies and special equipment.
Coordinate purchasing of supplies and special equipment with laboratory supervisor.
Assist with maintenance of laboratory equipment (service or replace).
Maintain cleanliness and organization within lab spaces, entrance areas, gowning rooms, lab hallways, and lab management storage areas.
Maintain a reference library of scientific catalogs, instruction manuals, keys, troubleshooting guides, and operation and parts manuals for laboratory equipment and models as requested.
Perform assigned responsibilities, duties, and tasks according to established practices, procedures, techniques, and standards in a safe manner and with minimal supervision.
Interact with equipment vendors on service calls.
Manage reagent / common consumables store / liaison with VWR
Liaison with EH&S and lab waste disposal services
Co-ordinate access requests and lab safety training
Communicate and co-ordinate lab usage requests / requirements
Daily lab maintenance / common area cleanup / lab space storage
Familiarity with safety data sheets and chemical hygiene practices
Complete simple ad-hoc requests from supervisors/managers and/or lab users
Ability to read, understand, and comply with detailed procedures that ensure the safety of all.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize duties to meet timelines.
Strong communication, organizational and time management skills are essential.
Detail-oriented and conscientious.
Perform clerical tasks as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned.
cond_0095.requirements:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing; ability to communicate effectively in a tactful and courteous manner with a variety of people, including laboratory employees, staff, outside suppliers and the general public
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules; ability to write routine reports and correspondence
Ability to follow technical instructions, procedure manuals, and charts to solve practical problems and/or ensure compliance with clear guidelines and standards
Knowledge of basic laboratory and clerical procedures; ability to operate laboratory and office equipment
Knowledge of Material Safety Data Sheets; knowledge of laboratory safety rules, policies and procedures
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, and diagram form
Ability to perform all essential functions using safe work methods and following safety regulations relating to job
Sufficient physical ability to work in a lab setting: stand or sit for prolonged periods, occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; lift, carry, push, and/or pull up to 25 pounds
Vision in the normal visual range with or without correction
Ability to work in a lab environment regularly exposed to fumes, airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, and moderate noise
Preferred Requirements
Related work or school experience
Ability to manage interpersonal conflict situations requiring tact, diplomacy and discretion; ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and a wide variety of co-workers
Ability to interpret policy and establish methods and procedures
Ability to accurately perform math calculations, solution preparations and troubleshoot when needed
Knowledge of ordering supplies and maintaining inventories of laboratory supplies/equipment
Familiarity with current lab equipment and information technology used by the department, including Microsoft Office, Outlook, and standard office machines

cond_0117.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team to help with routine laboratory tasks, including lab maintenance, cleanliness, and preparations.
cond_0117.responsibilities:
Employee must be able to perform the following functions to the satisfaction of the employee's supervisor.
Schedule preparation of routine laboratory buffers and solutions; coordinate with team members to maintain and reorder materials for buffers.
Complete daily laboratory walk-throughs and safety checks together with lab staff.
Store and dispose of hazardous wastes using safety procedures; help inform supervisors and staff of proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
Support enforcement of lab safety codes across all lab areas to help ensure employee safety.
Communicate with the laboratory supervisor regarding special needs and maintenance of laboratory facilities as needed.
Help maintain the inventory tracking system for all science supplies and special equipment.
Coordinate purchasing of supplies and special equipment with the laboratory supervisor.
Assist with maintenance of laboratory equipment (service or replace).
Work with the team to maintain cleanliness and organization within lab spaces, entrance areas, gowning rooms, lab hallways, and lab management storage areas.
Maintain a reference library of scientific catalogs, instruction manuals, keys, troubleshooting guides, and operation and parts manuals for laboratory equipment and models as requested.
Carry out assigned responsibilities, duties, and tasks according to established practices, procedures, techniques, and standards in a safe manner and with minimal supervision.
Coordinate with equipment vendors on service calls.
Help manage reagent and common consumables store; liaise with VWR.
Liaise with EH&S and lab waste disposal services.
Coordinate access requests and lab safety training.
Communicate and coordinate lab usage requests and requirements.
Daily lab maintenance, common area cleanup, and lab space storage.
Familiarity with safety data sheets and chemical hygiene practices.
Assist supervisors, managers, and lab users with simple ad-hoc requests.
Additional Duties:
Perform clerical tasks as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned.
cond_0117.requirements:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, in a tactful and courteous manner with a variety of people, including laboratory employees, staff, outside suppliers, and the general public
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules; ability to write routine reports and correspondence
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, and diagram form
Knowledge of basic laboratory and clerical procedures; ability to operate laboratory and office equipment
Knowledge of Material Safety Data Sheets and laboratory safety rules, policies, and procedures
Ability to perform all essential functions using safe work methods and following safety regulations
Ability to accurately perform math calculations, solution preparations, and troubleshoot when needed
Ability to read, understand, and comply with detailed procedures that ensure the safety of all
Ability to multi-task and prioritize duties to meet timelines
Strong communication, organizational, and time management skills
Detail-oriented and conscientious
Physical ability to work in a lab setting: stand or sit for prolonged periods; occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; lift, carry, push, and/or pull up to 25 pounds; operate equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard
Vision in the normal visual range with or without correction
Preferred Requirements
Related work or school experience
Ability to manage interpersonal conflict situations requiring tact, diplomacy, and discretion
Ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and a wide variety of co-workers
Ability to follow technical instructions, procedure manuals, and charts to solve practical problems and/or ensure compliance with clear guidelines and standards
Ability to interpret policy and establish methods and procedures
Knowledge of ordering supplies and maintaining inventories of laboratory supplies and equipment
Familiarity with current lab equipment used by [Company name masked]; current information technology used by the department, including but not limited to Microsoft Office, Outlook, and office machines such as telephones or copiers

cond_0345.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. Provide routine laboratory tasks to assist team members with lab maintenance, cleanliness and preparations.
cond_0345.responsibilities:
Employee must be able to perform the following functions to the satisfaction of the employee's supervisor.
Schedule preparation of routine laboratory buffers and solutions; maintain and reorder materials for buffers
Complete daily laboratory walk-throughs and safety checks.
Store and dispose of hazardous wastes using safety procedures; assist in informing supervisor and staff of proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
Enforce lab safety codes in all lab areas to ensure employee safety.
Communicate with laboratory supervisor regarding special needs and maintenance of laboratory facilities as needed.
Support inventory tracking system in place for all science supplies and special equipment.
Coordinate purchasing of supplies and special equipment with laboratory supervisor.
Assist with maintenance of laboratory equipment (service or replace).
Maintain cleanliness and organization within lab spaces, entrance areas, gowning rooms, lab hallways, and lab management storage areas.
Maintain a reference library of scientific catalogs, instruction manuals, keys, troubleshooting guides, and operation and parts manuals for laboratory equipment and models as requested.
Perform assigned responsibilities, duties, and tasks according to established practices, procedures, techniques, and standards in a safe manner and with minimal supervision.
Interact with equipment vendors on service calls.
Manage reagent / common consumables store / liaison with VWR
Liaison with EH&S and lab waste disposal services
Co-ordinate access requests and lab safety training
Communicate and co-ordinate lab usage requests / requirements
Daily lab maintenance / common area cleanup / lab space storage
Familiarity with safety data sheets and chemical hygiene practices
Complete simple ad-hoc requests from supervisors/managers and/or lab users
Ability to read, understand, and comply with detailed procedures that ensure the safety of all.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize duties to meet timelines.
Strong communication, organizational and time management skills are essential.
Detail-oriented and conscientious.
Additional Duties:
Perform clerical tasks as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned.
cond_0345.requirements:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of basic laboratory and clerical procedures.
Familiarity with safety data sheets, Material Safety Data Sheets, and laboratory safety rules, policies and procedures.
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, in a tactful and courteous manner with a variety of people including laboratory employees, staff, outside suppliers and the general public.
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules; ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, and diagram form.
Ability to perform all essential functions using safe work methods and following safety regulations relating to the job.
Comfort with operating laboratory and office equipment.
Ability to accurately perform basic math calculations and solution preparations, with willingness to troubleshoot when needed.
Experience with or willingness to learn Microsoft Office, Outlook, and standard office machines such as telephones and copiers.
Sufficient physical ability to work in a lab setting: standing or sitting for prolonged periods; occasionally stooping, bending, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and twisting; lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling up to 25 pounds; operating equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard.
Vision in the normal visual range with or without correction.
Preferred Requirements
Related work or school experience in a laboratory or similar setting.
Background in ordering supplies and maintaining inventories of laboratory supplies and equipment.
Openness to managing interpersonal conflict situations requiring tact, diplomacy and discretion.
Ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and a wide variety of co-workers.
Some exposure to interpreting policy and establishing methods and procedures.
Experience working in environments with fumes, airborne particles, or chemical hazards is a plus.

cond_0359.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team and take ownership of routine laboratory tasks, including lab maintenance, cleanliness, and preparations.
cond_0359.responsibilities:
Schedule and execute preparation of routine laboratory buffers and solutions; maintain and reorder materials for buffers.
Lead daily laboratory walk-throughs and safety checks.
Store and dispose of hazardous wastes using safety procedures; take responsibility for informing supervisor and staff of proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
Enforce lab safety codes in all lab areas to ensure employee safety.
Communicate directly with the laboratory supervisor regarding special needs and maintenance of laboratory facilities as needed.
Own and maintain the inventory tracking system for all science supplies and special equipment.
Direct purchasing of supplies and special equipment in coordination with the laboratory supervisor.
Manage maintenance of laboratory equipment (service or replace).
Maintain cleanliness and organization within lab spaces, entrance areas, gowning rooms, lab hallways, and lab management storage areas.
Build and maintain a reference library of scientific catalogs, instruction manuals, keys, troubleshooting guides, and operation and parts manuals for laboratory equipment and models as requested.
Execute assigned responsibilities, duties, and tasks according to established practices, procedures, techniques, and standards in a safe manner and with minimal supervision.
Lead interactions with equipment vendors on service calls.
Manage reagent and common consumables store; serve as liaison with VWR.
Liaise with EH&S and lab waste disposal services.
Coordinate access requests and lab safety training.
Manage lab usage requests and requirements.
Oversee daily lab maintenance, common area cleanup, and lab space storage.
Apply familiarity with safety data sheets and chemical hygiene practices.
Complete ad-hoc requests from supervisors, managers, and lab users.
Perform clerical tasks as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned.
cond_0359.requirements:
High School Diploma. Related work or school experience a plus.
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing; ability to communicate effectively in a tactful and courteous manner with a variety of people, including laboratory employees, staff, outside suppliers and the general public; ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules; ability to write routine reports and correspondence; ability to manage interpersonal conflict situations requiring tact, diplomacy and discretion; ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and a wide variety of co-workers; ability to follow technical instructions, procedure manuals, and charts to solve practical problems and/or ensure compliance with clear guidelines and standards.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, and diagram form; ability to interpret policy and establish methods and procedures; ability to perform all essential functions using safe work methods and following safety regulations relating to job. Knowledge of basic laboratory and clerical procedures; ability to operate laboratory and office equipment; ability to accurately perform math calculations, solution preparations and troubleshoot when needed; knowledge of ordering supplies and maintaining inventories of laboratory supplies/equipment; knowledge of Material Safety Data Sheets; knowledge of laboratory safety rules, policies and procedures; ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
EQUIPMENT AND SOFTWARE: Current lab equipment used by the company; current information technology used by the department, including but not limited to, Microsoft Office, Outlook, office machines such as telephones, or copiers.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Environment: Work is performed primarily in a lab setting with frequent interruptions and distractions; the employee is regularly exposed to fumes or airborne particles and toxic or caustic chemicals; the employee is frequently exposed to risk of chemical hazards, explosive hazards, burn hazards and electrical shock. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Physical: Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in a lab setting; to stand or sit for prolonged periods of time; to occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; to lift, carry, push, and/or pull up to 25 pounds; to operate office equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard; and to verbally communicate to exchange information. Vision: See in the normal visual range with or without correction.

cond_0459.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team to help with routine laboratory tasks, including lab maintenance, cleanliness, and preparations.
cond_0459.responsibilities:
Employee must be able to perform the following functions to the satisfaction of the employee's supervisor.
Schedule preparation of routine laboratory buffers and solutions; coordinate with team members to maintain and reorder materials for buffers.
Complete daily laboratory walk-throughs and safety checks together with lab staff.
Store and dispose of hazardous wastes using safety procedures; help inform supervisors and staff of proper hazardous waste disposal procedures.
Support enforcement of lab safety codes across all lab areas to help ensure employee safety.
Communicate with the laboratory supervisor regarding special needs and maintenance of laboratory facilities as needed.
Help maintain the inventory tracking system for all science supplies and special equipment.
Coordinate purchasing of supplies and special equipment with the laboratory supervisor.
Assist with maintenance of laboratory equipment (service or replace).
Work with the team to maintain cleanliness and organization within lab spaces, entrance areas, gowning rooms, lab hallways, and lab management storage areas.
Maintain a reference library of scientific catalogs, instruction manuals, keys, troubleshooting guides, and operation and parts manuals for laboratory equipment and models as requested.
Carry out assigned responsibilities, duties, and tasks according to established practices, procedures, techniques, and standards in a safe manner and with minimal supervision.
Coordinate with equipment vendors on service calls.
Help manage reagent and common consumables store; liaise with VWR.
Liaise with EH&S and lab waste disposal services.
Coordinate access requests and lab safety training.
Communicate and coordinate lab usage requests and requirements.
Daily lab maintenance, common area cleanup, and lab space storage.
Familiarity with safety data sheets and chemical hygiene practices.
Assist supervisors, managers, and lab users with simple ad-hoc requests.
Additional Duties:
Perform clerical tasks as needed.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as may be assigned.
cond_0459.requirements:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, in a tactful and courteous manner with a variety of people, including laboratory employees, staff, outside suppliers, and the general public
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules; ability to write routine reports and correspondence
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, and diagram form
Knowledge of basic laboratory and clerical procedures; ability to operate laboratory and office equipment
Knowledge of Material Safety Data Sheets and laboratory safety rules, policies, and procedures
Ability to perform all essential functions using safe work methods and following safety regulations
Ability to accurately perform math calculations, solution preparations, and troubleshoot when needed
Ability to read, understand, and comply with detailed procedures that ensure the safety of all
Ability to multi-task and prioritize duties to meet timelines
Strong communication, organizational, and time management skills
Detail-oriented and conscientious
Physical ability to work in a lab setting: stand or sit for prolonged periods; occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; lift, carry, push, and/or pull up to 25 pounds; operate equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard
Vision in the normal visual range with or without correction
Preferred Requirements
Related work or school experience
Ability to manage interpersonal conflict situations requiring tact, diplomacy, and discretion
Ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and a wide variety of co-workers
Ability to follow technical instructions, procedure manuals, and charts to solve practical problems and/or ensure compliance with clear guidelines and standards
Ability to interpret policy and establish methods and procedures
Knowledge of ordering supplies and maintaining inventories of laboratory supplies and equipment
Familiarity with current lab equipment used by [Company name masked]; current information technology used by the department, including but not limited to Microsoft Office, Outlook, and office machines such as telephones or copiers
